Original Article Title: Microsoft 365 Calendar を悪用：HOLLOWGRAPH という高ステルス性のマルウェア

The report details the use of malicious installers and infostealers, such as Vidar, which leverage legitimate-looking download sites and C2 infrastructure to compromise systems.
Source Title: Why Trust is the New Attack Surface: Mid-Year Threat Update 2026

Original Article Title: Testing a Prompt injection Attack Against an Enterprise AI Agent
Summary: Darktrace tested the vulnerability of enterprise AI agents to indirect prompt injection attacks delivered via email. The study demonstrated that behavioral analysis can successfully identify and quarantine these attacks, which often lack traditional malware indicators, by detecting anomalous language and context.
Source Title: Testing a Prompt injection Attack Against an Enterprise AI Agent

Original Article Title: Securing AI Agents: What NCSC Guidance Means for Security Teams
Summary: The UK's National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) has released interim guidance on managing cyber risks associated with agentic AI, emphasizing the need for robust controls as organizations deploy these systems. The guidance recommends aligning security measures with an agent's autonomy level, implementing strict identity and permission management, and maintaining human oversight.
Source Title: Securing AI Agents: What NCSC Guidance Means for Security Teams

Original Article Title: When AI Becomes the Lure: A Fake Gemini Installer Delivers Vidar
Summary: Attackers are increasingly exploiting interest in generative AI tools to distribute malware, as seen in a recent incident where a fake Google Gemini installer delivered the Vidar information stealer. The malware utilized a malicious download site and communicated with C2 infrastructure to facilitate credential theft.
Source Title: When AI Becomes the Lure: A Fake Gemini Installer Delivers Vidar
